== The Simple Journey ==


-- Story Background --

A traveler walks a road with no secrets.


-- Character --

Name
----
Fen

Background
----------
A wanderer with light pockets and a good memory.

Skills
------
Navigation: 3 (Competent)
Endurance: 2 (Unskilled)


-- Turn 1 --

Outcome
-------
You set off down the road.

- - - - -

Your objective: Reach the coast by nightfall.

- - - - -

Secret Information
------------------
A storm is coming from the west.

Tracked Items
-------------
Miles Walked:
0

Food Rations:
3

-- Turn 2 --

Action
------
Walk for several hours.

Outcome
-------
You reach a crossroads.

Secret Information
------------------
The left road is shorter but floods easily.
